svg.title: Runtime Observability Dock — dark theme
svg.desc: Source-backed topology of the collapsible Chat / Console dock: chat messages, Console node records, and terminal logs use distinct producers and retention paths, converge in WebSocketContext state, and render in a resizable chat pane plus Console and Terminal tabs with targeted filters and clear actions. Sources: client/src/components/ui/ConsolePanel.tsx; client/src/contexts/WebSocketContext.tsx; server/nodes/utility/console/__init__.py; server/services/status_broadcaster.py; server/routers/websocket.py; server/nodes/trigger/chat_trigger/_events.py; server/services/process_service.py; server/core/logging.py; docs-internal/node-logic-flows/chat_utility/console.md
svg.text: One resizable dock combines workflow chat, Console-node output, and live server/process logs without conflating their scopes.

Persisted dock preferences
g.text: height · split width · font · autoscroll · pretty print · tab
Scope and retention stay deliberately distinct
Chat and Console history are persisted and scoped to the current workflow; Terminal history is a process-wide in-memory buffer of the latest 200 entries.
The dock persists only presentation preferences in localStorage—panel height, split width, font size, auto-scroll, pretty print, and selected log tab.
